newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish govt wins confidence vote 118-70 -Speaker.
newsitem.headline: Finnish govt wins confidence vote 118-70 -Speaker.

text.p: The Finnish government on Friday won a vote of confidence in parliament, the legislature said in a statement.

In the vote -- on a government proposal to partly extend retail store Sunday opening hours -- 118 deputies supported Prime Minister Paavo Lipponen's left-right-green coalition, 70 were against, two abstained and nine MPs were not present, the house said.
Lipponen turned the issue into a vote of confidence after a similar proposal suffered a surprise defeat in parliament in December.
The parliamentary groups of the five government parties control 142 seats in the 200-member single-chamber legislature.
The government had been expected to win the confidence vote, its fifth since taking office in April 1995.
